name: baaton
description: Baaton for coding agents: read tickets, move them through statuses, post comments and TLDRs on baaton.dev — via API key or OAuth.

interface.longDescription: Work from your Baaton board without leaving Codex or ChatGPT: find the ticket to pick up, move it to In Progress, comment while you work, post a TLDR of what changed and hand it over for review. Connects via OAuth — no manual key setup. Also accepts a Baaton API key (BAATON_API_KEY) for CLI/dev use.
defaultPrompt: Use Baaton to show the open tickets of my project, highest priority first.
Use Baaton to move the ticket I just finished to In Review with a TLDR of the changes.

positive.description: List open tickets in my project
positive.prompt: Use Baaton to show me the open tickets in my project, highest priority first.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists open tickets sorted by priority in the connected org's project.

positive.prompt: Create a Baaton ticket titled 'Fix login redirect' with high priority.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an issue in the first accessible project and returns the display_id.

positive.prompt: Mark Baaton issue BAA-1 as in_review.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates the issue status to 'in_review' and returns the updated fields.

positive.description: Post a TLDR after completing work
positive.prompt: Post a TLDR on Baaton issue BAA-1 saying 'Fixed the auth redirect bug, changed src/auth.ts, tests passed'.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a TLDR record on the issue and returns the TLDR id.

positive.prompt: Search Baaton for issues about authentication.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns relevant issues matching 'authentication' from the connected org.

negative.prompt: Delete all issues in my Baaton project.
Show me my Baaton billing information.
Show issues from a Baaton organization I am not a member of.

review.commerce_description: Baaton is a SaaS product with its own billing. This plugin does not process payments or purchases.

publication.release_notes: v0.2.0: Remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP) with OAuth 2.1 via Clerk. Tools: get_profile, list_projects, list_issues, search_issues, get_issue, create_issue, update_issue, add_comment, post_tldr.
